fact: The police ICT Directorate's spokesman said the upgraded Crime Record Management System, pioneered in Kampala Metropolitan in 2017 and set back when station records officers found it hard to use, had been tested in Kampala, was soon to be tested at upcountry stations, and would be rolled out only once the Police Advisory Committee adopted a policy; case files were still kept by one records officer per station and by detectives.
title: Police upgrades Digital Crime Record Management System
